title: JPMorgan Chase blueprint to become first fully AI-powered megabank
snippet: JPMorgan is scaling its internal LLM Suite and agentic AI across research, markets, and client workflows as part of a firm-wide AI blueprint.

title: Goldman Sachs and BNY introduce money market fund digital tokens
snippet: Goldman Sachs and BNY created a path for institutions to buy tokenized money market funds, with BlackRock and Fidelity among early participants.

title: HSBC outlines digital banking and capital priorities
snippet: HSBC highlighted ongoing digital banking investment and capital planning amid evolving UK regulatory expectations for operational resilience.

title: Goldman Sachs partners with American Express on corporate cash management
snippet: Goldman integrated AmEx virtual-card technology into its transaction-banking platform to give corporate treasurers real-time payment visibility.

title: Morgan Stanley to open wealth management funnel to AI agents
snippet: Morgan Stanley plans to let corporate clients' AI agents pull data from ShareWorks and Equity Edge, expanding its wealth-management technology funnel.

title: UBS advances cloud and technology modernization for wealth platforms
snippet: UBS continues multi-year technology modernization intended to reduce operating risk across wealth-management platforms.

title: Fidelity publishes guidance on artificial intelligence for investors and advisors
snippet: Fidelity outlined how AI-assisted research and analysis tools can help advisors synthesize market commentary faster while managing model risk.

title: Bank of America stock rises 3% on strong trading day
snippet: Shares of Bank of America climbed after a broad market rally lifted financials.

title: Citigroup executives to speak at fintech summit in London
snippet: Citigroup leaders are scheduled to appear on a conference panel about payments innovation.

title: JPMorgan expands generative AI platform for institutional client workflows
snippet: A second outlet reports JPMorgan is expanding generative AI access across institutional client-facing teams via its internal LLM Suite.

title: Vanguard explores digital advice tooling for retirement participants
snippet: Vanguard is exploring partnerships and product enhancements to strengthen digital advice capabilities for retirement plan participants.

title: Barclays strengthens operational resilience after payments disruption review
snippet: Barclays outlined operational upgrades following an internal review of a payments outage affecting online and mobile banking.
